doc.title: Al Gallodoro interviewed by Monk Rowe, Oneonta, New York, December 28, 2005

title: Saxophone Contrasts and Gallodoro albums
summary: 1951 and 1958 albums, soon to be reissued.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums
